prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1489; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers responded to a two-vehicle collision in Pearland, Texas, involving a left turn at an intersection. Driver 1 was turning left when the front of their vehicle was struck by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the intersection. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred just as they described it, and independent witnesses at the scene gave consistent accounts. Scene photographs show damage concentrated at the front of Driver 1's vehicle and the driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle, which is consistent with the reported impact. Driver 1 reported a concussion and was evaluated at the scene. A Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle, and both officers and witnesses confirmed their presence. Officers found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the insured party on the coverage documents presented at the scene. Both drivers were cooperative, and no citations were issued at the time of the report.
